segments.he:
תּוֹרָה רכט
יֵשׁ עֵצִים שֶׁכְּשֶׁעוֹשִׂים מֵהֶם מִטָּה, מְסֻגָּלִים לְהוֹלָדַת בָּנִים וּלְגַדְּלָם, וְכֵן לְהִפּוּךְ, יֵשׁ שֶׁאֵינָם מְסֻגָּלִים וְכוּ':
segments.en: When a person sees that things are not going in order — let one know that one has arrogance — and do teshuvah. And humble oneself — and be in the aspect of mah [nothing]. And then things will return to going in order.
